purpose: Freeze source-derived FD4 and FD8 exact rational stencil/moment/remainder constants and a physically valid independent error-budget protocol BEFORE any integrated actual-grid all-sector H4 Ward test. This preregistration does not invent the missing physical derivative envelopes or assign a numerical Noether tolerance from the observed structural residual.

registered_source_only_compiler.FD4: Extract the five exact 5-point coefficient rows directly from the original Repair07 fd4_matrix AST, including first/second one-sided, interior, and last/penultimate rows. Confirm denominator 12*h and all original row placements.
registered_source_only_compiler.FD8: Extract the nine exact 9-point rational coefficient rows directly from the original Repair37 _FD8_W assignment AST and verify its full boundary/center stencil assignment. No reimplemented or optimized derivative replaces the production matrix.
registered_source_only_compiler.exact_moments: For each row i with offsets s_j=j-i, verify sum_j c_ij*s_j^k = delta_(k,1) for all integer 0<=k<=p, exactly as rational arithmetic, with p=4 or 8.
registered_source_only_compiler.registered_smooth_remainder: K_(p,i)=sum_j abs(c_ij)*abs(s_j)^(p+1)/(p+1)!, exact rational. For a C^(p+1) function on the entire corresponding stencil interval, |D_p f(x_i)-f_prime(x_i)| <= h^p K_(p,i) sup_stencil |f^(p+1)|.
registered_source_only_compiler.edge_controls: Report every distinct original stencil row and maximum K_p over all rows. Include both first and last boundary formulas, never use the central constant for edge nodes.
registered_source_only_compiler.scope: Original uniform x=ln(a), Nt64/Nt128; original H*D4 operator and H*D8 (GE06/GE07/Lambda/Y) versus H*D4 (GE05 M1/M2) source groups.

registered_physical_budget_protocol.precondition: Independently derive and certify local M5/M9 suprema for the actual physical time currents/shift rows and GE06/GE07/Lambda/Y and GE05 source fluxes on each Nt128/Nt64 original interval before inspecting combined all-sector W. For Y zero-gradient points, prove requisite local regularity or use a separate rigorously bounded lower-regularity modulus; no global C9 assumption.
registered_physical_budget_protocol.operator: B_op(m,i)=abs(H_i)*h^4*K4_i*M5(E_shift_total(m),i)+abs(k_m*a_i*H_i)*h^4*K4_i*M5((C14*w)(m),i). Original product C14*w must be differentiated before evaluating its derivative envelope.
registered_physical_budget_protocol.six_source: B_source(m,i)=abs(H_i)*(h^8*K8_i*sum_{p in GE06,GE07,Lambda,Y} M9(S_shift_p(m),i)+h^4*K4_i*sum_{p in GE05_M1,GE05_M2} M5(S_shift_p(m),i)). Each source term remains on its original frozen time grid and scheme.
registered_physical_budget_protocol.nonbath_parent: Independently derive per-sector Euler/current differentiation budgets with the ORIGINAL actual GE06/GE07/Lambda/Y action coefficients, signed lower-boundary product, spatial Fourier derivative and all original parent state and current representations. A missing Euler or boundary term is STOP, not a zero assumption.
registered_physical_budget_protocol.bath_parent: Use the separately frozen physical H4F3d7 both-one-sided original interval-H R_ODE and sampled D_FD4 decomposition for all 2048 nodes, all six positive modes and both endpoints. R_ODE is a physical on-shell consistency issue, NOT an FD tolerance. Do not absorb the near-unit H4F3d6 R_FD4 or tune its coefficient into a structural error budget.
registered_physical_budget_protocol.roundoff: Derive and freeze a conservative floating-point propagation bound for the original matrix construction, products, summations and H/clock factors. Polynomial exactness alone is not a floating-point bound; if an operation-level proof is unavailable, STOP rather than choose a residual-fitted floor.
registered_physical_budget_protocol.full_Ward: Only after every source-independent envelope and roundoff constant has been independently certified and frozen, define B_total by the exact signed operator/source/parent absolute error propagation. Compare on all original C x beta x Nt x m x t physical cohorts, including C_max beta=1 m=8 Nt128 index=3 and all active m=1..40. Do not derive B_total from W_total observed defects or selectively exclude high-frequency nodes.

outcomes.STENCIL_CONSTANTS_COMPILER_PASS_BUDGET_O: Both original stencil extractions and every exact rational moment/remainder gate pass. Freeze constants, but do not run the integrated physical Ward until missing independent physical derivative/regularity/roundoff bounds are frozen.
outcomes.STENCIL_CONSTANTS_COMPILER_FAIL: Any original source mismatch, exact moment failure, incorrect edge stencil or nonpositive remainder bound is an implementation/algebra failure. No physical test is licensed.
